findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp-registry" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: norman_de_company_formation, norman_pl_spzoo_formation · Private data: norman_de_company_formation, norman_pl_spzoo_formation · Public sink: norman_de_company_formation, norman_pl_spzoo_formation.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: norman_de_company_formation, norman_pl_spzoo_formation · Private data: norman_de_company_formation, norman_pl_spzoo_formation · Public sink: norman_de_company_formation, norman_pl_spzoo_formation

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "norman_de_company_formation" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
